mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST drops by more than 10% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past three months signals an easing monetary policy, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it indicates strong consumer demand, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS grows by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in the past month, it indicates a strong labor market, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: When both real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) show a simultaneous decline over the past quarter, it signals a broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline over the past quarter.
